title: Apache Airflow：半開資料區間與補跑完整性
titleEn: Apache Airflow: half-open data intervals and catchup completeness
subcategoryTitle: 科學工作流與資料契約
summary: 使用原創合成資料研究「Apache Airflow：半開資料區間與補跑完整性」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付區間清單、邊界事件歸屬、補跑政策與 logical date 對照。
summaryEn: Investigate Apache Airflow: half-open data intervals and catchup completeness using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver interval manifests, boundary-event assignments, catchup policy and logical-date mappings that distinguish represented data time from scheduler and execution timestamps.
scope: 本課採用原創合成工作負載或事件資料，在紙面、試算表與離線模型中實作。來源用於查證具名案例；數值、擾動與驗收門檻是教學假設，不是實機效能或正式環境變更規格。實驗限自己的或明確授權的隔離環境，交付可重算的證據紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original synthetic workloads or event data in paper, spreadsheet, and offline-model investigations. References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.
